{{Quote|Okay, Master Horn—tell me what the chubba is going on!|Leia Organa Solo, to [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]|<ref name="The Unseen Queen">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref>}}
'''Chubba''' was a swear word used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref> by people like [[W. Wald|Wald]],<ref name="Tatooine Ghost" /> [[Mara Jade Skywalker]],<ref name="The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> [[Tarfang]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]<ref name="The Unseen Queen" /> and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]], "chubba" is used as an alternate spelling of<ref name="TPM novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> "chuba," [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] for "Hey you!"<ref name="Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide real-life book">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref> The alternate spelling is used in quotes by [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] and [[Watto/Legends|Watto]].<ref name="TPM novel" />
